name: China Electronics Technology Group Corporation 58 Research Institute
zh: 中国电子科技集团公司第五十八研究所

evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Electronics Technology Group Corporation 58 Research Institute”, one of the research institutes of China Electronics Technology Group Corporation (CETC). CETC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists. The US Commerce Department listed it in August 2022 for acquiring and attempting to acquire US-origin items in support of China’s military modernization.
It belongs to CETC, which describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.

sources.title: Additions of Entities to the Entity List (87 FR 51876, 24 August 2022)
